children: DevSecOps platform's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 21%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 beat consensus
Company repurchased about 3.5 mln shares in the quarter
GitLab expects Q3 revenue between $281 mln and $283 mln
Company sees full-year revenue of $1.129 bln to $1.133 bln
GitLab forecasts FY 2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.85 to $0.87
ARR AND BOOKINGS GROWTH - Co said record gross bookings and net ARR growth over 40% y/y drove results, per CEO Bill Staples
CUSTOMER EXPANSION - Co cited sequential acceleration in dollar-based net retention and growth in customers with over $100,000 ARR, per CFO Jessica Ross
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 19 "hold" and 2 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GitLab Inc. is $40.00, about 14.1% below its August 31 closing price of $46.54
The stock recently traded at 51 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 36 three months ago
